auth.title: Log in

subtitle.customer: Get trusted local workers, with quotes you can compare

auth.phoneHint: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS
auth.invalidPhone: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
auth.wrongCode: That code is incorrect. {n} attempts left.
auth.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.staffOnly: Only Workerly staff can sign in here.

customer.heroBody: Describe the problem, get quotes from verified workers near you in Mohali and Chandigarh, and pay only what you approve.
customer.noRequestsHint: Tell us what needs fixing and verified workers nearby will send you quotes.
customer.ctaBody: Describe the problem, add a photo, and get quotes from verified workers nearby.

worker.noLeadsHint: Jobs near you will appear here once your profile is verified.
worker.becomeBody: Add your skills, service area and ID documents to start receiving jobs. It takes about 10 minutes.
worker.availabilityHint: Turn this off when you're busy or on leave.
worker.nowAvailable: You will now get job requests.
worker.nowUnavailable: You won't get new job requests.
worker.noLeadsApproved: New jobs near you will appear here.

admin.emptyBody: Worker verifications and disputes will show up here.
admin.rejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Photo is blurry, upload again
admin.decisionHint: Approve only if the ID matches the profile photo and name.
admin.nobodyMatched: Nobody matched: no available, verified worker with this skill covers this location.
admin.needsAttentionHint: Open with nobody invited, or no quotes after 30 minutes.

onboarding.title: Set up your Workerly Pro profile
onboarding.photoHint: A clear photo of your face. Customers see it.
onboarding.bioPlaceholder: e.g. Bathroom fittings, leak repair, geyser installation
onboarding.skillsHint: Pick the services you do. You will only get jobs for these.
onboarding.centerCity: Using the centre of {city}. Move the pin to where you work for better matches.
onboarding.documentsHint: Upload a photo or PDF. We only use these to verify you; customers never see them.
onboarding.fileHint: JPG, PNG, HEIC or PDF, up to 10 MB
onboarding.maskedAadhaar: Upload a masked Aadhaar only (first 8 digits hidden). Download it from the UIDAI website or app.
onboarding.stillMissing: Before you can submit, please add:
onboarding.readyToSubmit: Everything is ready. Our team usually reviews profiles within 1–2 working days.

missing.name: Your name
missing.service_area: At least one area where you work

pending_review.title: We're reviewing your profile
pending_review.body: This usually takes 1–2 working days. We'll send you an SMS when it's done.

rejected.title: Application not approved
rejected.body: Unfortunately we couldn't approve your profile. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: You won't receive jobs while your account is suspended. Please contact support.

draft.title: Profile not submitted
draft.body: Finish your profile to get verified.

requests.describePlaceholder: e.g. Kitchen tap is leaking and the pipe under the sink drips
requests.describeHint: Any language is fine. A few words and a photo are enough.
requests.photosHint: Up to {max} photos. Location data is removed from photos.
requests.analysing: Finding the right service for you…
requests.suggestedHint: We picked the service that seems to fit. Change it if it looks wrong.
requests.notSure: We're not sure which service this is. Please choose one.
requests.questionsTitle: A few details help workers quote accurately
requests.addressPrivacy: Workers see only your area until you book one of them.
requests.howSoon: How soon do you need someone?
requests.whatNext: Verified workers near you will see this and send quotes. You choose who to book — nothing is booked until you accept.
requests.sent: Request sent. Workers nearby will start sending quotes.
requests.discardBody: Your description and photos will be deleted.
requests.safetyBody: If you smell gas, see sparks or smoke, or water is near electrics: switch off the main supply, keep away, and call 112 in an emergency. Then send your request.
requests.waitingBody: We'll let you know when workers send quotes. This request stays open until {time}.
requests.cancelBody: Workers will no longer be able to send quotes.
requests.sentTo: Sent to {count} nearby worker. | Sent to {count} nearby workers.
requests.nobodyYet: No workers are free nearby right now. Our team has been alerted and will help.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.removeBody: Requests you already sent keep their address.
addresses.mapLabel: Map: tap or drag the pin to your home
addresses.localityHint: Workers see only this before you book.
addresses.label: Name this address
addresses.outsideArea: Workerly doesn't serve this location yet. We're in Mohali and Chandigarh.

map.tapToPin: Tap the map or drag the pin to the exact spot.
map.pinSet: Pin set. Drag it to adjust.
map.gpsUnavailable: This device can't share its location.
map.gpsDenied: We couldn't get your location. Tap the map instead.

leads.offDuty: You're set to unavailable. Switch it on to receive jobs.
leads.alertsOn: You'll get a notification on this phone when a job comes in.
leads.alertsOff: Get a notification on this phone when a job comes in, even when the app is closed. Otherwise we send an SMS.
leads.alertsBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings. We send an SMS meanwhile.
leads.gone: This job is no longer available
leads.goneHint: The customer may have cancelled it, or it has expired.
leads.safety: The customer reported something that may be dangerous. Take care and check before you start.
leads.privacy: You'll see the exact address and phone number only if the customer books you.
leads.quotesFull: This job already has the maximum number of quotes, so it's closed to new ones.
leads.quotesSoFar: No quotes yet | 1 quote so far | {count} quotes so far
leads.withdrawBody: The customer won't see it any more, and you can't quote on this job again.

quote.title: Quote: {category}
quote.fixedHint: You know the job: list the work and the parts.
quote.inspectionHint: You need to see it first: charge a visit fee and send the final price after.
quote.notesPlaceholder: What's included, what isn't, anything they should prepare
quote.estimate: How long will the work take?
quote.updated: Quote updated. The customer now sees the new price.
quote.privacyNote: Don't add your phone number. The customer gets it when they book you.
quote.priceNote: The customer pays exactly this total. Workerly's fee comes out of your earnings, not their price.
quote.tooLarge: Quotes above {max} need our support team.

jobs.title: Jobs you won
jobs.none: No jobs yet. Jobs appear here when a customer accepts your quote.
jobs.nextSteps: Use the buttons above as the job moves along. Paying in the app is coming soon.
jobs.timeSet: Visit time saved. The customer has been told.
jobs.finalHint: Itemise the repair. The customer approves it before you start.
jobs.changeHint: Only the extra work or parts. The customer must approve before it's added.
jobs.completeBody: The customer will be asked to confirm and rate the work.
jobs.cancelBody: The customer is told and can book someone else.
jobs.waitingApproval: Waiting for the customer to approve {amount}
jobs.owedHint: Only prices the customer approved count.
jobs.contactHidden: Contact details are hidden now that the job is over.
jobs.collectHint: The customer can pay in the Workerly app, or pay you in cash. If they pay cash, confirm it here.
jobs.cashBody: Confirm you received {amount} in cash. Workerly's commission on this job will be taken from your next payout.

compare.title: Quotes
compare.none: No quotes yet. They appear here as soon as workers send them.
compare.inspectionNote: This is a visit fee. The worker sends the final price after seeing the problem, and you approve it separately.
compare.jobsDone: No jobs yet | 1 job done | {count} jobs done
compare.acceptBody: You agree to pay {total}. {name} gets your address and phone number, and the other quotes are declined.
compare.acceptInspection: You agree to pay the {total} visit fee. {name} gets your address and phone number. You approve the final price separately.
compare.changed: The worker just changed this quote. Check the new price before booking.
compare.notFound: This quote is no longer available.

booking.title: Booking confirmed
booking.whatNext: {name} will call you to agree a time. Paying in the app is coming soon.
booking.notScheduled: {name} will set a time with you.
booking.rejectFinalTitle: Say no to the final price?
booking.rejectFinalBody: The visit fee of {fee} is still due, and your request opens again for other workers' quotes.
booking.rejectChangeTitle: Say no to the extra charges?
booking.rejectChangeBody: Nothing is added to your bill. The worker carries on with the agreed work.
booking.owedHint: Only prices you approved. Paying in the app is coming soon.
booking.cancelBody: The worker is told. Your request opens again for other quotes if there's time left.
booking.cancelFeeBody: The worker has already visited, so the visit fee of {fee} is still due.
booking.chatClosed: Chat has closed for this booking.
booking.disputeHint: Within 7 days of the job. Our support team will contact you.
booking.disputed: Problem reported. Support will contact you.
booking.disputeOpen: You reported: {category}. Support is looking into it.

reviews.title: Your reviews
reviews.none: No reviews yet. They appear here after customers rate finished jobs.

pay.hint: Pay online once you're happy with the work, or pay {name} in cash.
pay.failed: The payment didn't go through. You can try again.
pay.processing: Your payment is being confirmed. This page will update shortly.
pay.checkoutUnavailable: The payment page couldn't load. Check your connection and try again.
pay.fakeBody: Development mode: no real money moves. Choose what the payment gateway should report.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.notYet: The invoice is issued once the booking is paid in full.

earnings.title: Your earnings
earnings.heldHint: From jobs paid online, after Workerly's commission.
earnings.owedHint: From jobs paid in cash. Taken from your next payout.

finance.dashboardHint: Worker balances, payouts, refunds and the daily reconciliation.
finance.refundOnlineHint: The money goes back to the customer's original payment method. This is recorded in the audit log.
finance.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in rupees, e.g. 250 or 250.50.
finance.balancesHint: Held = online earnings Workerly owes the worker. Owed = commission the worker owes on cash jobs. Payouts pay out the difference.
finance.payoutHint: Record a bank or UPI transfer you've already made to {name}. Their {owed} owed commission is settled first.
finance.payoutTooMuch: You can pay out at most {amount}.

issue.staleOrders: Unpaid orders over a day old

finance.rulesHint: The most specific rule wins (city + category, then category, then city, then everywhere). Rules can't be edited: add a new one with a later start date to replace it.

voice.title: Voice note
voice.hint: Easier to say it? Up to 2 minutes, in any language.
voice.micDenied: Allow microphone access to record a voice note.
voice.transcribing: Turning your voice note into text…
voice.noTranscript: We couldn't turn this into text, but the recording is saved.
voice.privacy: Workers see the text with phone numbers removed. Only the worker you book can hear the recording.
voice.afterBooking: You can listen to the recording once you're booked.

aiQuality.title: AI triage quality
aiQuality.hint: How often the AI's category matched what the customer finally chose. Customers always confirm the category, so their choice is the answer.
aiQuality.preselectedHint: {share} of suggestions were confident enough to pre-select
aiQuality.coverageHint: {triaged} of {submitted} submitted requests had a suggestion
aiQuality.calibrationHint: If accuracy doesn't rise with confidence, the 60% pre-select threshold needs revisiting.
aiQuality.noData: No triaged requests in this period.
aiQuality.evalHint: Before changing the model or prompt, run bin/rails "ai:eval[triage]" against the labelled set.

pwa.title: Install the app
pwa.iosSteps: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.workerReason: Get new job alerts like a normal app, even on iPhone, and open Workerly Pro from your home screen.
pwa.customerReason: Open Workerly from your home screen and get updates on your quotes and bookings.
